summary: North Haven Net REIT filed an 8-K to designate two new classes of common shares (Class L-S and Class L-I) with preferences substantially similar to existing classes plus additional repurchase limitations. The company also entered into a Fourth Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement creating corresponding partnership units, and a Second Amended and Restated Dealer Manager Agreement to facilitate distribution. No consideration, premium, or closing terms are disclosed. This is a routine capital-structure modification, not a special situation event.
